rules: Source sheets retained; edits fully logged; original owner/RACI/detail columns preserved.
Existing 20 variants remain distinct; no source rows removed.
People lanes use human teams; Maker/Checker duties stay separate.
Application names, IDs, qualifiers and existing mapping rows remain unchanged.
Mutually exclusive TRUE/otherwise tax branches use XOR, not inclusive OR.
Missing apps/data stay missing; no new hosting assignments or BDEs invented.
Control references are not a complete BPMN flow graph; display order is not execution order.
Prior process-specific timeout/parking decisions are not silently approved for every variant.
Source PDF/hash claims are retained but not independently verified against unavailable documents.

Process Step.Process Step: Submit onboarding request - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Requestor submits onboarding requests with mandatory attributes and evidence references; Tracking ID created.

Process Step.Process Step: Triage and classify - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Ops reviews request, classifies route (FD/SA), urgency, sets SLA and assigns maker.

Process Step.Process Step: Completeness gateway - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Mandatory fields/evidence check; fail → AOB-PR-1001-V01-S004, pass → AOB-PR-1001-V01-S005.

Process Step.Process Step: Request clarification (fail path) - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Return to requestor with reason codes; loop to AOB-PR-1001-V01-S003.

Process Step.Process Step: Business approval - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Business approver confirms request is valid and authorised.

Process Step.Process Step: Approval event gateway - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Wait for approve/reject/withdraw/timeout; timeout → escalation.

Process Step.Process Step: Create onboarding draft - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Maker maps request to draft, creates v1 + change log.

Process Step.Process Step: Package for ingestion - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Create ingestion package, apply naming/checksum/encryption.

Process Step.Process Step: Ingest to landing - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Platform ingests package; schema validation.

Process Step.Process Step: Technical error handling - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Incident created; retry/park decision (max 2 retries).

Process Step.Process Step: Parallel validations start - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Run DQ, enrichment, duplicate detection in parallel; join at AOB-PR-1001-V01-S015.

Process Step.Process Step: Execute DQ ruleset - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Automated DQ checks: completeness, code sets, date logic, uniqueness.

Process Step.Process Step: Reference enrichment - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Standardize country/currency/team codes.

Process Step.Process Step: Duplicate detect & merge decision - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Detect duplicates; merge/reject/proceed decision.

Process Step.Process Step: Validation join - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Consolidate parallel outputs into Validated Draft.

Process Step.Process Step: Conditional SPECIALIST checks - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Determine if Process SPECIALIST review is required based on explicit Tax Review Basis derived from Process Status and Process Type.

Process Step.Process Step: Process SPECIALIST review (conditional) - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: SPECIALIST reviews tax-triggered cases.

Process Step.Process Step: DQ pass gateway - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Evaluate DQ + Merge + Specialist outcomes; fail → AOB-PR-1001-V01-S019, pass → AOB-PR-1001-V01-S020.

Process Step.Process Step: Remediation loop - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Maker corrects and resubmits; max 3 attempts; loop to AOB-PR-1001-V01-S011.

Process Step.Process Step: Maker-checker (4-eye) - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Checker reviews, approves/rejects with reasons; logged for audit.

Process Step.Process Step: Publish to onboarding master - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Publish to Azure Data Lake master; stamp lineage/audit.

Process Step.Process Step: Write controls & DQ metrics - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Persist DQ results, approvals, remediation history to controls dataset.

Process Step.Process Step: Distribute to Downstream Systems (transaction) - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Parallel fan-out; record per-consumer status; allow replay.

Process Step.Process Step: Publish to DDT (alias: External Consumer A (Market Data) or Downstream Consumer A) - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Produce DDT-specific extract and deliver.

Process Step.Process Step: Publish to Portfolio Analytics Platform (ANALYTICS CONSUMER B (HACKATHON) OR AZURE SYNAPSE/DATABRICKS ANALYTICS WORKSPACE) (alias: Analytics Platform) - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Deliver via API MANAGEMENT + AZURE FUNCTIONS (OR API INTEGRATION LAYER (AZURE API MANAGEMENT)) to Analytics Consumer B with retries and idempotency using Tracking ID.

Process Step.Process Step: Publish to Client Reporting Hub topic - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Publish event/message to Reporting Consumer C (Hackathon) or Downstream Reporting Hub (Consumer C) via Azure Service Bus Topic.

Process Step.Process Step: Record publication events - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Append delivery events for audit/replay/monitoring.

Process Step.Process Step: Update DQ dashboard - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Refresh dashboard with status + DQ metrics.

Process Step.Process Step: Notify completion - Retail Account Onboarding
Process Step.Description: Notify requestor/stakeholders with outcome + Tracking ID.

Generation Notes.Notes: Corrected synthetic metadata for every source process. PDF v0.4 sections 9/10 govern the baseline: 62 detail rows and 76 data rows per process. No execution logs or real customer data.

Reference workbook rows reviewed against the PDF; Excel-only [added] rows removed; PDF controls, applications and schemas restored. Wording is normalised, not a verbatim transcription. Source row suffixes retained in generated IDs.

All source rows preserved. Duplicate IDs receive V01/V02 suffixes; mapping records original IDs. Applying the same 29-step PDF onboarding model to each business process is a synthetic assumption, not a claim about its actual workflow.

Process -> Process Step -> Process Step Detail and Process Step Data. Application links originate from application details; attribute links originate from data rows. Details and data are siblings, not a one-to-one chain.
PDF section 10 has no data rows for steps 003, 005, 011, 024, 025 or 026. These steps remain in the workbook; no data rows have been invented. Section 9 does not assign applications to every step.
No Tax Classification, Specialist Review Trigger, domain-specific attributes, inferred application details or proposed terminal flow branches from the earlier workbook are included.
PDF rule retained: Process Status = TAXABLE OR Process Type in tax-review-required list. The list and the lifecycle status vocabulary are not supplied; no values are invented.

Section 9 names Azure Monitor Alert / Incident Record (Hackathon); section 10 says ServiceNow incident; section 11 says Incident Management Tool. These source differences are retained pending owner confirmation.

Responsible Groups in section 9 appears to correspond to Process Teams in sections 6/10; retained as written pending confirmation. Lineage ID (lineage_id) and Published Timestamp (published_ts) map to their section 6 canonical attribute names.
The PDF runs enrichment and duplication in parallel but specifies Enriched Record as duplicate input. That unresolved dependency is retained; this workbook does not invent an execution order.

Only explicit section 9 application rows are linked to section 11 IDs. Composite file/API alternatives create two links, not two mandatory channels. Reference lookup, controls dataset and notification qualifiers stay in Detail Value. Unlinked inventory entries are retained.
Completion requires master publication and publication events for the Tracking ID, not successful delivery to every consumer; failures may remain pending replay.
Business Data Domain source column maps to Business Data Domain Owner; Domain to Data Domain; Utility (illustrative) to Capability. Original source values remain available in Source Process.
